faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our premium studio and training college

q1.a: Teme Upholstery is a premium automotive interior craftsmanship studio specializing in luxury car upholstery, leather installation, and professional training programs.

q2.a: Teme Upholstery was established to provide high-quality automotive interior solutions and professional craftsmanship training in Ethiopia.

q3.a: We provide luxury car interior design, leather seat upholstery, roof lining restoration, dashboard wrapping, and professional training courses.

q4.a: Yes. Our automotive upholstery training college teaches practical interior craftsmanship and modern vehicle interior techniques.

q5.q: How long does upholstery work take?
q5.a: Depending on project complexity, most interior work takes between 1 to 5 days.

q6.a: We are located in Ethiopia and serve clients nationwide.
